rounds.prompt: The archive is close. Choose the final passage!

choices.label: The Keeper's Vault
choices.description: A secret locked away for ages

choices.label: The Tidal Throne

choices.label: The Sunken Observatory

drowned-dock.name: The Drowned Dock
drowned-dock.discovery: The old dock creaks beneath the waves. Three mysterious routes open before the crew.

coral-gate.name: The Coral Gate
coral-gate.discovery: A cathedral of coral parts at your approach. A tiny brass compass glints between the branches.

bell-tower.name: The Drowned Bell Tower
bell-tower.discovery: The bell tolls once as your crew arrives. The sound travels much farther than it should.

glass-trench.name: The Glass Trench
glass-trench.discovery: A ribbon of blue light guides you along the crystal floor. Something sparkles in the current.

shell-library.name: The Shell Library
shell-library.discovery: An entire history is etched into a single pearl shell. The community adds the first chapter.

moonwell.name: The Moonwell
moonwell.discovery: The water shows a sky full of unfamiliar stars. A new constellation appears when the crew looks closer.

ship-graveyard.name: The Ship Graveyard
ship-graveyard.discovery: Hundreds of ships rest in the sand. One has a lantern burning in its porthole.

keeper-vault.name: The Keeper's Vault
keeper-vault.discovery: The vault opens to reveal a map covered in the names of the people who found it.

tidal-throne.name: The Tidal Throne
tidal-throne.discovery: Your crew claims the throne for the whole community. A new expedition awaits.

sunken-observatory.name: The Sunken Observatory
sunken-observatory.discovery: The final telescope points toward the surface—toward a sky full of possibility.

rounds.prompt: The forest whispers your name. Which trail answers back?

choices.label: The Fern Path
choices.description: A trail swallowed by green

choices.label: The Foxglove Den
choices.description: Warm light below the roots

choices.label: The Singing Stones
choices.description: A melody in the distance

rounds.prompt: A familiar song drifts through the trees. Where to?

choices.label: The Old Oak
choices.description: The oldest tree in the forest

choices.label: Firefly Lake
choices.description: Lights dance on still water

choices.label: The Mushroom Ring
choices.description: A circle of pale caps

rounds.prompt: One last clearing lies beyond. Which way does chat guide the crew?

choices.label: The Star Meadow
choices.description: A field beneath the open sky

choices.label: The Hollow Hill
choices.description: Music behind a green door

choices.label: The Hidden Grove
choices.description: A sanctuary at the forest's heart

mossy-clearing.name: Mossy Clearing
mossy-clearing.discovery: A circle of sunlight lands in the heart of the forest. Three trails wind away.

fern-path.name: The Fern Path
fern-path.discovery: Ferns curl aside as you pass. Tiny footprints lead toward a warm glow.

fox-den.name: The Foxglove Den
fox-den.discovery: A family of foxes has made a home beneath the roots. They leave you a bright red feather.

singing-stones.name: The Singing Stones
singing-stones.discovery: The stones hum the tune back. The forest seems glad that you came.

old-oak.name: The Old Oak
old-oak.discovery: A tree with a thousand years of stories offers a place to rest.

firefly-lake.name: Firefly Lake
firefly-lake.discovery: The lake is a mirror of green and gold; the fireflies draw a glowing map on its surface.

mushroom-ring.name: The Mushroom Ring
mushroom-ring.discovery: A tiny door appears in the biggest mushroom. Someone inside is making tea.

star-meadow.name: The Star Meadow
star-meadow.discovery: Fireflies flicker like distant constellations over the sleeping grass.

hollow-hill.name: The Hollow Hill
hollow-hill.discovery: The hill's green door swings open to the sound of a welcoming fiddle.

hidden-grove.name: The Hidden Grove
hidden-grove.discovery: A quiet sanctuary blooms around an ancient spring. You found it together.

rounds.prompt: The jump gate flickers to life. Which star calls to the crew?

choices.label: The Violet Nebula
choices.description: A cloud of color and stardust

choices.label: Quiet Moon
choices.description: A pale dot beyond the rings

choices.label: Signal 9
choices.description: A voice coming from nowhere

rounds.prompt: The ship's sensors detect a curious signal. Investigate?

choices.label: Crystal City
choices.description: A glimmer on the dark side

choices.label: The Comet Garden
choices.description: A green streak across the stars

choices.label: The Drift Market
choices.description: Lanterns floating in space

rounds.prompt: One more jump to make this voyage unforgettable. Choose wisely!

choices.label: The Last Beacon
choices.description: A light at the edge of the chart

choices.label: The Blue World
choices.description: An ocean planet below

choices.label: The Homeward Star
choices.description: The way you came, transformed

wayfarer-dock.name: Wayfarer Dock
wayfarer-dock.discovery: The ship is fueled and the chart is blank. Where will the crew go?

violet-nebula.name: The Violet Nebula
violet-nebula.discovery: A violet cloud stretches farther than the ship can see. Something is blinking inside.

quiet-moon.name: Quiet Moon
quiet-moon.discovery: The moon is silent except for soft radio music that sounds a lot like your stream intro.

signal-9.name: Signal 9
signal-9.discovery: The voice on the radio belongs to someone charting the same stars, somewhere far away.

crystal-city.name: Crystal City
crystal-city.discovery: A city of crystal catches the nearby starlight and sends it back as a greeting.

comet-garden.name: The Comet Garden
comet-garden.discovery: A garden drifts in the comet's wake. You collect a seed that hums gently.

drift-market.name: The Drift Market
drift-market.discovery: Travelers from a dozen worlds make room at the table. The crew is welcome here.

last-beacon.name: The Last Beacon
last-beacon.discovery: The beacon has been waiting a thousand years to deliver one message: you are not alone.

blue-world.name: The Blue World
blue-world.discovery: Clouds swirl over an ocean planet. A new world is ready to be discovered together.

homeward-star.name: The Homeward Star
homeward-star.discovery: The star you set out from looks different now. The voyage changed everyone aboard.
